title: Idle Animations
description: Idle Animations makes standing still feel alive. After ten seconds without movement, your player begins performing polished ambient poses while a smooth cinematic camera moves around the scene.
body:
Idle Animations  
Idle Animations makes standing still feel alive. After ten seconds without  
movement, your player begins performing polished ambient poses while a smooth  
cinematic camera moves around the scene.  
Features  
36 refined animations with conservative head, torso, arm, and leg motion  
Context-aware poses selected from the item in your hand  
Sword animations including samurai stance, guard, flourish, inspection, and meditation  
Specialized poses for bows, crossbows, shields, pickaxes, tools, torches, maps, books, and food  
Twelve smooth cinematic shot patterns, including orbit, overhead, leg sweep,  
crane, rising arc, close sweep, descending, low-angle, shoulder, and reveal shots  
Animations and cinematic shots run together  
Per-frame model reset prevents bent or stuck body parts  
Cinematic mode immediately stops when you move, turn, use an item, or open a screen  
Restores your previous camera perspective automatically  
Configurable idle delay, animation cooldown, cinematic toggle, and shot duration  
Client-side only; no server installation required.  
Installation  
Install Fabric Loader for your Minecraft version.  
Install Fabric API.  
Download the Idle Animations JAR matching your exact Minecraft version.  
Place both mods in your client's mods folder.  
This mod is client-side only. Other players need the mod installed to see the  
animations on their own clients.  
Supported Versions  
Minecraft 1.20.1  
Minecraft 1.21.1  
Minecraft 1.21.11  
Minecraft 26.1.2  
Each Minecraft version uses a separate JAR because player rendering and camera  
APIs differ between versions.  
Modpack Permission  
You may include the official, unmodified Modrinth release of Idle Animations in  
modpacks. Re-uploading or distributing modified copies requires permission.
